lumenforge.option.caustica_enabled.toolt: Enable Caustica's Vulkan ray-traced renderer. Turning this off returns to the vanilla/Sodium renderer after a full Minecraft restart; Vulkan RT device features cannot be changed live. This does not disable the Caustica mod jar.
lumenforge.option.rr.tooltip: Denoise and reconstruct the path-traced image with NVIDIA DLSS Ray Reconstruction.
lumenforge.option.quality.tooltip: Performance modes render fewer internal pixels; Quality and DLAA trade speed for detail.
lumenforge.option.spp.tooltip: Path-tracing samples per pixel each rendered frame. Higher values reduce noise but cost substantial GPU time.
lumenforge.option.bounces.tooltip: Maximum secondary light bounces after the primary hit.
lumenforge.option.entities.tooltip: Include entities and block entities in the ray-traced scene.
lumenforge.option.particles.tooltip: Render particles as billboards inside the traced scene.
lumenforge.option.water.tooltip: Animate water-surface normals for moving highlights.
lumenforge.option.entity_pbr.tooltip: Use physically based material maps for ray-traced entities when supplied by a compatible resource pack.
lumenforge.option.opacity_micromaps.tool: Use supported GPU opacity micromaps to accelerate cutout geometry. Hardware support is required.
lumenforge.option.opacity_detail.tooltip: Micromap subdivision level for fine cutouts. Higher levels can increase build cost and memory use.
lumenforge.option.torch_emission.tooltip: Caustica emission for torches, lit candles, lanterns, and end rods in the enabled LumenForge light-boost pack. Apply to reload resources in-game. This does not extend the light-sampling range in Caustica 0.1.1.
lumenforge.option.exposure.tooltip: Auto adapts to scene luminance. Manual uses the exposure value directly.
lumenforge.option.auto_exposure_bias.too: Small global adjustment to Auto exposure. Keep near zero for normal daylight. This is stored separately from Manual Exposure EV.
lumenforge.option.exposure_ev.tooltip: Fixed exposure used only in Manual mode. It is stored separately and will not brighten Auto mode when you return outdoors.
Maximum exposure Auto mode may apply in very dark areas. This is only an upper bound; Auto bias and scene metering still determine the actual brightness.
lumenforge.option.auto_target_gray.toolt: Mid-gray luminance targeted by Caustica's automatic exposure. Raising it brightens both interiors and exteriors; start at 18%.
lumenforge.option.auto_exterior_floor.to: Lowest EV automatic exposure may select in bright scenes. Lower values allow stronger darkening outdoors.
lumenforge.option.adapt_dark.tooltip: Caustica adaptation time when moving into darker areas. Lower values respond faster.
lumenforge.option.adapt_bright.tooltip: Caustica adaptation time when moving into brighter areas. Lower values respond faster and help avoid temporary outdoor overexposure.
lumenforge.option.hdr_enabled.tooltip: Enable Caustica HDR display output. Requires an HDR-capable display and a full Minecraft restart.
lumenforge.option.paper_white.tooltip: Brightness of ordinary white content on an HDR display. Has no effect while HDR Output is off.
lumenforge.option.peak_nits.tooltip: Display highlight peak for Caustica HDR output. Set to the display's actual peak luminance.
lumenforge.option.gamma.tooltip: Post-transform gamma. Lower values lift shadows and midtones.
lumenforge.option.frame_generation.toolt: Generate interpolated frames between rendered frames. Requires supported NVIDIA hardware and a FIFO swapchain present mode.
lumenforge.option.generated_frames.toolt: Generated frames per rendered frame. The RTX 4060 driver currently reports a maximum of one.
lumenforge.option.reflex.tooltip: Reduce the render queue and coordinate frame pacing with the GPU.
lumenforge.option.reflex_boost.tooltip: Keep GPU clocks elevated while Reflex is active. Uses more power.
lumenforge.option.fps_target.tooltip: Reflex pacing target before generated frames. Zero disables the limiter.
lumenforge.option.debug_view.tooltip: Inspect ray-tracing buffers after the normal frame has rendered.
lumenforge.option.frame_stats.tooltip: Write detailed render-frame timing and hitch information to the game log.
lumenforge.option.omm_stats.tooltip: Write opacity micromap build statistics to the game log.
lumenforge.option.crash_diagnostics.tool: Enable expensive vendor driver diagnostics for device-loss investigations. This can heavily reduce performance and requires a restart.
lumenforge.option.restore_recommended.to: Restore LumenForge's Beautiful-profile Caustica controls, independent Auto/Manual exposure, and fixture glow. Does not reset Sodium, SPBR, or worlds. Requires confirmation; renderer and HDR changes need a restart.
lumenforge.reset.title: Restore LumenForge Recommended Settings?
lumenforge.reset.message: This replaces your tuned LumenForge/Caustica values with the Beautiful preset (Auto bias 0, Auto ceiling +6 EV, Manual +6 EV). Unsaved video-setting edits will be discarded. Sodium, resource-pack selection, and worlds remain unchanged.
